title: Customer reactions to comfort and feature design
summary: This topic combines sparse customer reactions about seat comfort, control layout, lighting features, and an unresolved trade-in request, with most examples lacking clear sentiment labels.

positive.summary: The positive feedback praises the headrest comfort concept while noting a desire for forward-back adjustment.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined examples mention liking interior or exterior lighting, finding the lack of a Park button odd, requesting a similar feature elsewhere, and one unresolved case about wanting to trade the vehicle due to anxiety.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, so clear sentiment conclusions are limited.
